steps.name: model-imports
command:
import json, importlib.metadata as m
import numpy, cv2, torch, torchvision, timm, vggt_omega, ultralytics, robot_control, openai_codex
from vggt_omega.models import VGGTOmega
from ultralytics.models.sam import SAM3SemanticPredictor
from clip.simple_tokenizer import SimpleTokenizer
tokenizer = SimpleTokenizer()
print(json.dumps({'versions': {d:m.version(d) for d in ['numpy','opencv-python','torch','torchvision','timm','vggt-omega','ultralytics','clip','mujoco','pin','robot-control','openai-codex']}, 'source_paths': {n:getattr(module,'__file__',None) for n,module in [('vggt_omega',vggt_omega),('ultralytics',ultralytics),('robot_control',robot_control)]}, 'tokenizer_tokens':len(tokenizer.encode('robotic arm')), 'cuda_available':torch.cuda.is_available()}, indent=2))

steps.name: model-imports-isolated
command:
import json, importlib.metadata as m, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy, cv2, torch, torchvision, timm, vggt_omega, ultralytics, robot_control, openai_codex
from vggt_omega.models import VGGTOmega

tokenizer = SimpleTokenizer()
data = {'versions': {d:m.version(d) for d in ['numpy','opencv-python','torch','torchvision','timm','vggt-omega','ultralytics','clip','mujoco','pin','robot-control','openai-codex']}, 'source_paths': {n:getattr(module,'__file__',None) for n,module in [('vggt_omega',vggt_omega),('ultralytics',ultralytics),('robot_control',robot_control)]}, 'tokenizer_tokens':len(tokenizer.encode('robotic arm')), 'cuda_available':torch.cuda.is_available()}
